events.title: Andy Grove named Intel CEO
events.summary: Andy Grove became Intel CEO on October 18, 1987 when Gordon Moore stepped down — leading Intel through the PC boom.
events.about: Grove's 'Only the Paranoid Survive' culture pushed Intel's x86 dominance and manufacturing discipline. He turned Intel into the world's largest chipmaker during the Windows/PC era.

narrative.whyChosen: Grove defined Intel's operational excellence during the microprocessor wars.
narrative.whyImportant: His leadership secured x86 as the standard PC and server architecture.
narrative.problemSolved: Intel needed aggressive execution to win the 386/486 battles against AMD and Cyrix.
